svg.text: Service tails: p99.9 versus requested p99.99
Same retained forks | ordinary get | 512 MiB G1 | three pairs/point | no new benchmark runs
p99.99: Caffeine service is lower at every tested primary point for both payloads. The 256 B p99.9 reverse crossover does not carry over.
Dots: individual forks; large dot: median; bars: min–max, not CI. Hollow dots retain warnings. 256 B midpoints use the later runtime.
